newsitem.title: USA: U.S. junk bond issues up, Spinnaker issue may grow.
newsitem.headline: U.S. junk bond issues up, Spinnaker issue may grow.

text.p: Fresh U.S. high-yield bond issues traded up at midday as cash flow remained strong, while secondary debt languished in choppy trade, dealers said.

The solid bid for new issues prompted an upsizing of Spinnaker Industries Inc's $100 million 144A 10-year note deal, sources said, but the amount of the increase was unclear. BT Securities Corp is lead manager on the deal.
Kaiser Aluminum and Chemical Corp's $175 million 144A senior note issue due 2003 traded at 99-5/8, up from Thursday's issued level of 99-1/2.
Rayovac Corp's $100 million 144A 10-year senior subordinated notes traded at 101 near mid-session, up from par pricing on Thursday. The notes have a 10-1/4 percent coupon.

Aames Financial Corp's $150 million senior notes due 2003 traded more than one point higher at 100-7/8. The notes were priced at 99.714 for a spread of 275 basis points over the U.S. Treasury curve by Bear Stearns & Co on Tuesday.

Outside new issue talk, traders echoed frustrations in the secondary as syndicate desks appeared to have an exclusive with investors. Talk of heavier supply through November depressed prices, led by some more troubled companies.

Marvel Holdings' zero coupon bonds due 1998 continued to take punches and traded at 38 before mid-session, almost half of their value just nine days ago, traders said. The bonds traded at 43 on Thursday.

The debt began its slide after the Marvek Entertainment Group warned of a third quarter net loss that would put the company in violation of certain bank loan financial covenants. Moody's Investors Service and Standard & Poor's have since cut their ratings on the Marvel debt.

Separately, Trump-related debt was off one point or more in the wake of a lawsuit that alleges Donald Trump inflated the value of his Trump's Castle Casino Resort before its sale in September, one head trader said.
Trump Castles traded at 101 compared with 103 before the news, traders confirmed. Trump Atlantic City Funding $1.2 billion 11-1/4s of 2006 were down about one point.
Investment grade trade was quiet following a brisk week of new issues there, traders said. Most new issue paper was trading at issue bid.
Prices were rose in the broad marketplace in sympathy with the U.S. Treasury curve. The Treasury 30-year bond was quoted up 12/32 to yield 6.77 percent at 1324 EDT/1724 GMT.
